implementation_strategy: Execute conservative_single_repair scenario using hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: for each of 200 reproducible synthetic intent-to-configuration tasks, call the hosted LLM once to generate a shared initial candidate (baseline) and, when deterministic validator flags actionable error, call the LLM once with deterministic, templated repair prompt to produce the guarded final config. Deterministic validator and simulator run on CPU; all scoring and exclusions are automated per adapter rules. Total maximum model calls = 200*(1 initial + 1 repair) = 400; estimated_model_calls set to 400.
public_resources: synthetic_multivendor_taskbank_v1 (public templates and seeds to be published in execution manifest)
task_manifest_strategy: Publish full task bank templates, seeds, and deterministic sampling script in execution repository; tasks indexed 1..200.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Provide deterministic templates for validator feedback→repair prompt, vendor template insertion, and parsing/normalization in repo; unit tests validate transformations.
randomisation_plan: Deterministic stratified sampling across vendor families with fixed seed; task ordering within batches deterministic.
caching_plan: Cache deterministic validator results and parsed ASTs locally; model-call outputs archived; no optional external resources.
failure_recovery_plan: On API call failure: automatic retry up to 2 times (same seed). If still failing, mark pair excluded from primary analysis per missingness_plan; record in manifest. Infrastructure restarts logged.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (baseline_actionable_error {0,1}, guarded_actionable_error {0,1}, initial_config, final_config, validator_traces, repair_prompts, model_call_ids)
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated hosted-model calls 400 under adapter quota (max 10000). Deterministic validator and simulator run on CPU; docker available for containerized validator. Wall-clock execution expected <7 days including retries and audits.
